...as I'm sure you saw, I was getting into the swing
of things!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Comme tu peux le voir, je me prépare corps et âme.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Into the swing...?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Pourquoi ça ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
We're going to meet someone amazing in next year's
‘<RGB FF6D18>The Great Ace Attorney</RGB>’ game, you know.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Une "miraculeuse rencontre" nous attend à
la sortie de "A Great Era" l'année prochaine.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
But I think <RGB FF6D18>the person</RGB> in question is going to make
a brief advance debut here tonight.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Mais il semblerait que cette rencontre aie lieu plus
tôt que prévu, aujourd'hui, dans cette cour de justice.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
And as a proud young Japanese man, I want to show
my fellow star what I can do!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
J'ai envie de montrer toute la valeur des hommes
japonais !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Oh, what a wonderful attitude!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Oooh ! Vous êtes si valeureux !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Still...it's a bit unsettling, isn't it?
At night...in this big courtroom, I mean...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Mais, l'Old Bailey m'effraie un peu ce soir.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
You're probably still feeling scared after seeing
the Hall of Horrors at the Tower of London earlier.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
C'est sans doute "Le musée des horreurs à la tour de Londres"
qui fait encore effet sur vous.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Yes...you've researched all the best places to
visit in the capital, that's for sure.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
C'est toi qui avais cherché tous les lieux à visiter
de London.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
I've already planned our itinerary for tomorrow,
which includes an even more terrifying exhibition!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
J'ai listé tous les musées des horreurs que nous
visiterons demain !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: <RGB 18D7FA>(I also – shock, horror – enjoy non-terrifying sights...)</RGB>
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: (Il n'y a pas que ça à voir à London, tu sais...)

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: By the way, do you, um...hear something?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Dis, t'entends pas quelque chose depuis tout à l'heure ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Well, they do say that the Old Bailey is haunted...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
À vrai dire...
J'ai entendu dire que l'Old Bailey était hantée.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Don't! Please!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Arrête !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
I'm still on tenterhooks after all the talk of ghosts
we heard at the Tower earlier!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Je suis sensible depuis qu'on a visité cette tour
tout à l'heure !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: AAA-CHOO!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Atchoum !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: AAAH!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Haaaaaaaaaaaa !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Who, who's there?!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Qui va là ?!

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Of course... Yes, I see it all laid out before
me now.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Je vois...
Il semblerait que j'ai déjà élucidé cette affaire.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
The truth...illuminated once again by another
great deduction.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Ma grande déduction s'avère être la vérité.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
You, sir, are without doubt...
<RGB FF6D18>a murdered Italian chef</RGB>!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Vous n'êtes autre que... Ah oui !
Le cuisinier italien assassiné !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Huh?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Quoi ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Dear me. Unaware of your own passing, roaming the
corridors and halls of the great courthouse...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Vous hantez cette salle d'audience, sans même savoir
que votre âme à quitté votre corps.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Huh? Huh?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Hein ? Quoi ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
When you've been killed, my dear fellow, it is
customary...to drop dead!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Faites donc comme le bon mort que vous êtes
et tombez raide mort... Cadavre !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Huuuuuuh?!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Quoiiiiiiiiiiiii ?!

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
AAAAAAAAAGH!
You're... You're...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Aaaaaaaah !
Mais vous êtes...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
You're the world-famous great detective,
Mr <RGB FF6D18>Herlock Sholmes</RGB>!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Le détective de renommée mondiale, Sherlock Holmes !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Ah, you've heard of me?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Tiens ? Vous me connaissez ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Oh yes! I'm a devoted follower of your wonderful
exploits!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Bien sûr !
J'ai lu toutes vos aventures !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
‘The Adventures of Herlock Sholmes’ is
delivered all the way to Japan by steamship!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Je fais venir mes copies des "Aventures de Sherlock Holmes"
par bateau !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: ‘Elementary, my dear Wilson!’
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: "Élémentaire, mon cher Watson !"

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Oh! That's exactly what I read in the stories!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Aaaah !
C'est comme dans mes livres !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
‘Once you eliminate the impossible, whatever remains,
no matter how improbable, must be the truth.’
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
"Une fois l’impossible éliminé, tout ce qui
reste, aussi improbable soit-il, doit être la vérité"

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Yes! That too!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Aaaah !
Ça aussi c'était dans mes livres !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Are the stories full of <RGB FF6D18>gross delusions</RGB>, too?
Like the notion that I'm dead...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: ... Alors c'était quoi ces accusations tout à l'heure ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
‘A great deduction and a gross delusion are
but a hairbreadth apart!’
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
"Seule Dame chance peut différencier
une "déduction" d'une "accusation"".

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Oh... That isn't what I read in the stories.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Ça, c'était pas dans mes livres...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Where exactly did you get the idea that I'm a
murdered Italian chef?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Mais... C'était quoi cette histoire de chef
italien assassiné ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: An excellent question...my dear cordon bleu.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Très bonne question, mon petit chef.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
So...shall we begin? Allow me to present
Herlock Sholmes's logic and reasoning!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Sherlock Holmes va dès à présent
commencer ses déductions !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Earlier today I received a telegram with details
of a case that prompted me to come here.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Je suis venu ici après avoir reçu un télégramme
détaillant toute l'affaire.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
‘An Italian chef has been murdered in the
Old Bailey’.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: "COUR SUPRÊME, CHEF ITALIEN ASSASSINÉ"

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: An Italian chef...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Cour suprême...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: In the Old Bailey...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Chef italien...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Quite! I have a thorough grounding in the Japanese
language. There can be no mistake in my translation!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Exact ! Je maîtrise parfaitement les katakana !
Je n'aurais jamais fait d'erreur en les lisant !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
And I immediately observed the foreign blade at
your side. Clearly to <RGB FF6D18>slice</RGB> carpaccio.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Cette lame d'une contrée étrangère... Vous ne pouvez
être qu'un grand cuisiner.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
The star-patterned buttons of your jacket – 
an unmistakable mark of <RGB FF6D18>your skill</RGB>.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Ces cinq étoiles à votre veste, preuves de votre talent.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
And your Eastern appearance might fool a layman,
but not <RGB FF6D18>a well-travelled detective</RGB>.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Votre visage à première vue asiatique mais, à l'ère
de la globalisation, je ne ferais pas d'amalgame.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
And the blood-stained dagger in your back is a
sure sign that you're <RGB FF6D18>no longer of this world</RGB>.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Enfin, cette lame plantée dans votre dos, preuve
de votre trépas.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Accordingly, there can be no doubt.
You are Italian! You are a chef! And you are dead!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
N'importe qui devinerait que vous êtes
italien. Mort. Et chef !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
They do say...that the Old Bailey is haunted,
you know.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: ... Après tout, on raconte bien que ces lieux sont hantés.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: That ‘great deduction’...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Votre grande déduction...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
...was blatantly <RGB FF6D18>cooked up on the spot</RGB> to fit the
telegram!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Vous avez tout inventé après avoir lu le télégramme !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
But my dear fellow, you have a knife lodged in
your spine. What other explanation can there be?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Et que faites-vous de ce couteau qui dépasse de votre
dos ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Ah, this?
This is just a plaything.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Ah, ça ?
C'est un jouet.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Pardon?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Eh.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
We bought them on a whim at the Hall of Horrors
exhibition at the Tower of London.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
On les a achetés dans la boutique souvenir du
musée des horreurs de la tour de London.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
.........
Don't tell me...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
.........
Ne me dites pas que...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
...that you're about to make some preposterous
claim about not being dead at all?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Vous avez l'intention de me dire que vous
n'êtes pas mort !?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: I'M ALIVE!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Je ne suis pas mort !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: But...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: ... Mais !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
...if you're not a murdered Italian chef,
then who the devil are you?!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Si vous n'êtes pas le chef italien assassiné,
qui êtes-vous ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Yes!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Hein ?!

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
I'm a defence lawyer by the name of
<RGB FF6D18>Ryunosuke Naruhodo</RGB>.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Je m'appelle Hikari Yûno, avocat !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
I'm a visiting student from the Empire of Japan
here to further my knowledge of the law.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Je suis venu au Grand Empire Britannique en échange
universitaire pour étudier le droit.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: And I am <RGB FF6D18>Susato Mikotoba</RGB>...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Et moi, je m'appelle Amimo Amiéyama.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: ...Mr Naruhodo's <RGB FF6D18>judicial assistant</RGB>.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Je suis son assistante juridique, toujours
prête à le sauver.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: ...Or so you say...to mask your actual identity.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: De simples masques...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
The truth is you're an Italian chef! You cannot
deny there's at least a distinct possibility of it!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Un chef italien ! Voila votre véritable identité !
N'y a-t-il aucune chance que j'aie raison ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: There isn't!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Aucune !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Um, Mr Sholmes...might I have a look at the telegram
you received?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: M. Holmes, pourrais-je jeter un œil à ce télégramme ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: W-Wait, this...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Attendez...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
You only have to read the first word to see...
there's a clear <RGB FF6D18>inconsistency</RGB>!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Une contradiction... se cache dans ce télégramme !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: There is?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Quoi ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Look more closely. It doesn't say ‘<RGB FF6D18>Old Bailey</RGB>’
at all...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Regardez bien, ce n'est pas écrit "Cour Suprême", mais...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: It says ‘<RGB FF6D18>Old Daily</RGB>’!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: "Corte Suprema" !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Old...Daily?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Corte Suprema ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Oh, of course!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Si je me souviens bien...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
There is an Italian restaurant called ‘<RGB FF6D18>Old Daily</RGB>’
just around the corner.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Juste à côté du tribunal se trouve un restaurant
italien du nom de "Corte Suprema".

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
Named after the terrifying army cannon they fire
every day to bake their famous ‘pizza’.
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Leur spécialité semble être la "Pizza di guillotina".

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Are, are you sure?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Vous en êtes sûr ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: Oh yes. Clearly...
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Certain...

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
...your interpretation of the crime scene written
in that telegram was a complete <RGB FF6D18>mistranslation</RGB>!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Vous vous êtes trompé en lisant le japonais du télégramme !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: GAAAAAAAAARGH!!!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Ghaaaaaaaaaa !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
...What business does a <RGB FF6D18>Japanese</RGB> telegram have in
a British escapade anyway...?
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Pourquoi est-ce que l'Angleterre envoie ses
télégrammes en japonais ?

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
And that brings us to the end of this little tale.
But we shall see you soon in the game, I'm sure!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
C'est la fin pour cet épisode.
Nous nous reverrons dans le jeu !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
You may even be astounded by more of my great
deductions!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
La prochaine fois, je vous montrerai toute l'étendue
de mes capacités de déduction.

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
And you'll certainly be astounded by the great
delicacies we're cooking up for the courtroom!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr:
Et vous dégusterez les bons petits plaidoyers que 
je vous préparerai !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en:
In that case, my dear cordon bleu, a dish of your
finest carpaccio, if you please!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Un carpaccio pour la salle d'audience n°4, Chef !

special_movie00_Message_eng.en: THAT WAS A METAPHOR!
special_movie00_Message_eng.fr: Je vous l'ai dit ! Je suis ni italien, ni cuisinier !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>September, 2017
Makuhari Messe</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Septembre 2017
Japon, Makuhari Messe

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
I hereby call this court to order for this
retrospective of fifteen years of Ace Attorney.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Je déclare l'audience spéciale pour les
15 ans de la série Ace Attorney ouverte.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Are the defence and prosecution ready to proceed?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: La défense et l'accusation sont-elles prêtes ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Erm...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Excusez-moi...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...I'd be more ready...if I had a clue where
I was.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Avant de commencer...
Où sommes-nous ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
This is the Supreme Court of Judicature in the
Empire of Japan...in the Meiji era.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Nous sommes à la cour suprême de l'empire japonais.
Celle-là même de la grande ère Meiji.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
WHAAAAAAAAAT?!
That's like...a looong time ago, right?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Quoiiiiiiiii ! La grande... ère Meiji ?!!!

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Ooh, maybe we'll get to meet some of our
ancestors!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Oh ! Mais alors... 
On pourra peut-être croiser nos ancêtres !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...Maya, seriously, could you be any less
surprised?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: T'as pas l'air surprise, Maya...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
It would seem that some sort of time warp has
taken place...but no matter.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Il semblerait que l'espace-temps soit distordu.
Rien de bien grave.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
So how about the prosecution?
Are you ready to proceed?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Bien, l'accusation est-elle prête ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Um...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Eh bien...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Well, the thing is, I'm actually, um...
a defence lawyer.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Comment dire... Je suis avocat, moi.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Be that as it may, circumstances dictate that
for today, you shall stand for the prosecution.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Au vu des circonstances, nous vous avons choisi
comme procureur.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...Circumstances dictate it? I think perhaps he
means the powers that be dictate it...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
... Et j'imagine que nous n'avons pas le droit
d'entendre ces circonstances.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
I hope you don't think I'm being rude,
Mr Prosecutor, but...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Veuillez m'excusez, Monsieur le procureur, mais...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...who exactly are you?
You seem...strangely familiar.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Qui êtes vous ?
Vous m'avez l'air étrangement familier.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Interesting... I was just thinking the same thing.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Je me disais exactement la même chose.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
It's hard to explain. It's almost as if I know
you as well as I know myself...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Comment dire... On n'a pas l'air bien différents,
vous et moi.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Well, I think the fastest way to resolve this is
to have you both introduce yourselves.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Dans ce cas, je demande aux deux parties de se présenter.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Of course. I'm Defence Attorney...
<RGB 18D7FA>Phoenix Wright</RGB> / <RGB FF6D18>Ryunosuke Naruhodo</RGB>!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Je m'appelle Phoenix Wright/Hikari Yûno !
Avocat de la défense !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Oh...I thought you might share a surname or
something.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Tu le connais ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
But you could be brothers, couldn't you?
I mean, you both have that same...spikiness!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Seriez-vous frères ?
C'est vrai que vous êtes tous les deux très piquants.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
I think I might remember if I had a long-lost
brother, Miss Susato.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
... Je ne me souviens pas avoir été séparé d'un frère
à ma naissance.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
.........
I remember.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
...........
Ça me dit quelque chose.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Yeah, being told there was an attorney named
Ryunosuke Naruhodo somewhere in my family tree.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Je pense bien avoir un ancêtre du nom d'"Hikari",
avocat qui plus est.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
So, you did share a surname once?
And gramps over there is...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Ah ! Alors, ce vieux monsieur là-bas, c'est...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: ...One of my ancestors!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Mon ancêtre !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: WHAAAAAAAAAT?!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Quoiiiiiiiiii ?!

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...I think she just called you a grandfather,
Mr Naruhodo.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
... Elle n'a même pas bronché quand elle vous a
appelé "vieux monsieur".

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: I suddenly feel very old...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Je viens de prendre un coup de vieux...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: AAAAAAAAAH!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Aaaaaaaah !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Then...then...that must mean...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Attendez...
Ça veut dire que...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...you, standing beside him... You must be one
of MY ancestors!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Vous là, à côté...
Vous devez être mon ancêtre !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: ...Pardon?

You're dignified and ladylike and...well...
basically my ideal ancestor!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Belle et élégante !
Exactement comment je l'imaginais !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
I'm your great, great, grand-something
Maya Fey!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: C'est moi, Maya Fey, votre descendante !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Ah, well...I'm Judicial Assistant Susato Mikotoba,
I'm afraid.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
C'est que... Je m'appelle Amimo Amiéyama...
Assistante juridique...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Huh?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Hein ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: In other words, a total stranger.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: De parfaits étrangers.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Uuugh...I just can't catch a break.
I mean, wow, that is BITTER disappointment...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Mmmmh... Pourquoi est-ce que je me sens abattue, tout
d'un coup ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: ...I hope you can forgive me.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Vous m'en voyez vraiment désolée...
J'imagine ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Ooh! I know!
I can fix this!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Si ça ne vous dérange pas...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
You could become an honorary ancestor of the
Fey family!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Vous ne voulez pas devenir mon ancêtre ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
‘Susato Fey’...? Well it, it does have a certain
ring to it, I'm sure, but...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: "Amimo Fey" ? C'est vrai que c'est un joli nom...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
I think we might have just heard the most
illogical request in history.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
C'est sans doute la demande la plus absurde de
toute l'histoire de l'humanité...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Uuugh, but it really does have such an awesome
ring to it. Susato Fey...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Mmmh, ça sonnait si bien... "Amimo Fey".

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
This trial will discuss the fifteenth anniversary
of Ace Attorney that's being celebrated this year.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Aujourd'hui, nous allons passer en revue l'année des
15 ans d'Ace Attorney.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Fifteenth anniversary?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Qu-Quinze ans, vous dites ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
You better believe it! The very first Ace Attorney
was released back in 2001.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Exactement ! C'est en 2001 que le premier "Ace Attorney"
a vu le jour...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
And to celebrate that fact, we've been doing a whole
bunch of stuff this year.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Pour marquer le coup, beaucoup d'événements ont eu
lieu cette année.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: That's right! Like in January, we put on a huge event.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Ouais ! Y a eu un grooos événement en Janvier.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
The ‘15th Anniversary Special Trial’!
It was sooo much fun!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
"Procès anniversaire des 15 ans".
C'était trop bien !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
It was. It really drove home the impressiveness
of our fifteen-year-long history.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Ça, tu peux le dire. On a vraiment pu ressentir
le poids des 15 ans de la série.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Un instant !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
If I might be permitted...to make a small
observation.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Permettez moi une remarque, je vous prie.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Oh! Sure...what is it?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: B-Bien sûr.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
If driving home the impressiveness of a long
history was the intention...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Si vous vouliez organiser une commémoration
anniversaire...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...then you should have been celebrating the more
than one hundred years since Mr Naruhodo's birth!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Ne devriez-vous pas d'abord célébrer le centenaire de Hikari ?!

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: More...more than one hundred years?!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Cen-Centenaaaaaire !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...All this impressiveness just makes me feel
impressively old.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Arrête, Amimo. Cent ans c'est trop lourd, je vais
m'écrouler.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Wonderful, wonderful! The court bows down before
your ancient wisdom!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Il nous faut respecter nos aïeux.
Merci, ô vénérables ancêtres.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: I think...they've started to worship you.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Il nous... vénère ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Let's try not to mention the Meiji era again.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
On devrait pas dire que l'on vient de Meiji si
librement...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Don't forget that last year we took to the stage and
finally appeared in a TV anime series, too!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Il y a aussi eu la pièce de théâtre et l'anime
à la télé !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
A new story every week! I mean, that was really
ace, right?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: J'attendais la suite chaque semaine !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Un instant !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Tee-vee...?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: ... Thé-Lait ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: A-ni-me...?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: ... Annie-mais ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
What on earth are you talking about?
Stop half-explaining things!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
N'allez vous pas nous expliquer de quoi diable
vous êtes en train de parler ?!

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
<RGB 18D7FA>(A hundred years is a terrifying chasm to
bridge...it really is.)</RGB>
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: (C'est donc ça, le choc des génération...)

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Ah, and there was another interesting development
this year, wasn't there?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Oh, vous semblez oublier quelque chose.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
An orchestral concert. The first in nine years,
if I'm not mistaken.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Le concert orchestral !
En grand retour après 9 ans !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
You're not mistaken! With nine years of pent-up
emotion inside, I cried so hard!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
9 ans d'émotions en un concert !
J'en ai versé une larme.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Un instant !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Or-kes-tral...?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: ... Orc-Estre ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Kon-sert...?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: ... Con-sert ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Ah! A Western instrumental group performance!
Even we ancestors know about those!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Ah ! Une représentation musicale, vous voulez dire !
Dit comme ça, même les anciens peuvent comprendre !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Beethoven...Mozart...Bahha...
Oh, how delightful!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Betôben (貝多芬) ! Mozaruto (莫差特) ! Ba'ha (巴哈)!
Quelle belle musique !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Well, I've never heard of that last one, but sure,
you get the idea.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
J'arrive pas à lire ce qu'elle dit, mais elle a l'air
d'avoir compris.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
I think it's Bach. Things can get a bit bent out of
shape when you mould Western names into Japanese.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Pourquoi les Japonais écrivaient tout en idéogrammes ?
J'y comprends rien.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Right? Didn't they used to call Shakespeare
‘Sao’ or something?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
C'est pas faux.
Shakespeare c'était "Sao", je crois.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
You could have that cool ‘o’ on the end of your
name, Nicko!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Du coup toi tu aurais été "Féo" !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: ...Like ‘o’ for ‘old man’? No thanks.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Arrête, je vais prendre un coup vieux, moi aussi.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: And a matter of days ago, on August 3rd...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Enfin, le 3 août dernier est sorti...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...to great anticipation across the Empire of Japan,
The Great Ace Attorney 2 went on sale!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Ace Attorney : A Great Era 2 ! Attendu par tous
les citoyens du Grand Empire du Japon.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Oh! Um...thank you very much, Your Excellency!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Ah ! Oui !
Merci beaucoup !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Yeah, we really enjoyed that one.
What a story!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: On y a joué, nous aussi !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: It was so moving! I was blown away!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: J'étais trop émue !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: I bet you were. After all...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Moi aussi. Faut dire...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...there were a LOT of loose ends that needed
tying up!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Tous les mystères sont enfin résolus !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Ugh!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Ghh... !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Are, are you okay?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: J'ai dit quelque chose qu'il fallait pas ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: ...You just...touched a nerve, that's all.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Vous venez de me rappeler toute la pression de ces
dernières années.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Your ancestor went through rather a lot, you see.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: La vie de vos ancêtres n'a pas été de tout repos.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
It all started with our great forefathers,
after all.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Après tout, tout a débuté avec vos aïeux.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: We are truly blessed to be in your presence.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Merci, ô vénérables ancêtres.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Objection !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Forgive me, Your Honour, but...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Votre Honneur...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...that last statement of yours is riddled with
contradictions!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Ce que vous venez de dire contient une immense contradiction !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
W-What?!
Explain yourself, Mr Wright!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Que dites-vous ?!

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
It's been bothering me right since the start of
this trial, actually.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Ça me turlupine depuis un moment, déjà.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
The way Mr Naruhodo moves. It's very smooth.
A little...too smooth, I think.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Mes aïeux, vos mouvements sont terriblement fluides.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Oh, is it? I, I didn't notice.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Ah bon ? C'est vrai.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Exactly! Just like that!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Exactement !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: You're right, Nick...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: T'as raison...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Like, when you thump the bench, it's really jerky.
There's only two frames.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Quand toi tu frappes sur le bureau, t'es trop rigide.
T'as que 2 images d'animation.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Out of interest, what does your ‘objection’
look like?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: D'ailleurs, pourrais-je voir votre "Objection" ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Objection!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Objection !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Objection!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Objection !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: ...That's not actually humanly possible, surely.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Il se moque de moi, là.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
The point is this!
The jerkiness on this side of the courtroom...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Peu importe !
Cette rigidité est la preuve que...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...proves that we're your predecessors!
In other words...WE are the ancestors here!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: C'est moi, votre ancêtre et prédécesseur !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: ...What can I say to that?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Il a pas tort...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Perhaps you're both predecessors and ancestors
of each other.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Donc, vous êtes tous deux l'ancêtre de l'autre.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
If this is some sort of warping of time, that
should be entirely possible, I think!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Après tout, l'espace-temps est distordu,
c'est tout à fait normal !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Well, I think we've covered everything now.
It's time for this court to adjourn.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: ... Sur ce, la séance est levée.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Um, in that case...
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Euh, en fait...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...how are we supposed to get back home?
You know, to the twenty-first century?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Comment est-ce qu'on rentre chez nous ? Au 21e siècle.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Well...you could go and explore Meiji Tokyo
and pass the time that way!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Pourquoi pas ne pas tuer le temps en faisant
un peu de tourisme ?

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Huh?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Hein.

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
The great imperial capital is full of wonders.
I'm sure a hundred years will pass just like that!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Tokyo est magnifique ! Vous ne verrez même pas
les 100 ans passer !

.........
On dirait bien que...

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
...I think this is a perfect opportunity to use
that timeless phrase of mine, don't you?
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: C'est à moi que revient le droit de dire le "mot de la fin".

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Ooh! A joint predecessor-ancestor performance!
What a treat!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Oh ! Ancêtre et prédécesseur.
Un duo de rêve !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Altogether now, then...for the continued success
of Ace Attorney!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr:
Pour un futur radieux pour Ace Attorney.
Tout le monde, ensemble !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: One, two...
<CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Objection !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en: Maya! Put the brakes on!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Maya ! À l'aide !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
You know what they say:
what goes around comes around.
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: "La roue tourne", comme on dit !

special_movie01_Message_eng.en:
Goodbye for now, everybody.
See you again soon!
special_movie01_Message_eng.fr: Au revoir et à la prochaine !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>Ryunosuke Naruhodo's Seven Days of Sin
Evening of Day One</CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Hikari Yûno dans
Les sept nuits du péché - 1re nuit</CNTR>

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>2nd July, 5:00 p.m.
The Old Bailey Courtroom</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>2 juillet, 17h
Tribunal de Old Bailey</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I hereby call to order this trial of the defendant,
<RGB FF6D18>Ryunosuke Naruhodo</RGB>.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Je déclare le procès de <RGB FF6D18>Hikari Yûno</RGB> ouvert.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
Are the counsels for the prosecution and the defence
ready to proceed?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: La défense et l'accusation sont-elles prêtes ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
Judicial Assistant <RGB FF6D18>Susato Mikotoba</RGB> for the defence...
is ready, My Lord.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Assistante juridique <RGB FF6D18>Amimo Amiéyama</RGB>.
Prête, Votre Honneur.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
For the prosecution, I, <RGB FF6D18>Herlock Sholmes</RGB>,
naturally stand in full readiness.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Sherlock Holmes</RGB> pour l'accusation.
Prêt, naturellement.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: And I, naturally...am not ready for this at all.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Et naturellement...
Je ne suis pas prêt du tout.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I don't even know what it is that I'm supposed to
have done.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Mais enfin ! D'abord !
De quoi est-ce que je suis accusé, au juste ?!

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: No, that's right.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: C'est vrai...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
When I heard that Mr Naruhodo was in trouble,
I hurried here at once.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
J'ai accouru dès que j'ai entendu que M. Nick était
dans la panade, mais...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
But I have no information about the charge brought
against him at all.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
... Personne ne m'a dit quel était le chef
d'accusation.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I haven't done anything! <RGB FF6D18>The Great Ace Attorney</RGB> is
due to go on sale next week.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Je n'ai rien fait ! Ces derniers jours, je n'ai fait
que de me prélasser !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I'm just trying to keep a low profile and prepare
mentally for busy times ahead, that's all!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Je me préparais mentalement pour la sortie de
<RGB FF6D18>"Ace Attorney: A Great Era"</RGB> la semaine prochaine !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: Mr Naruhodo, your brazenness knows no bounds.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Votre courage m'impressionne...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
To call yourself a defence lawyer, having committed no
less than <RGB FF6D18>seven</RGB> crimes of the most serious nature!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Prétendre au poste d'avocat alors que vous-même
êtes coupable de <RGB FF6D18>sept</RGB> gigantesques péchés.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: Wait! SEVEN crimes?!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Sept "péchés"... ?!

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: What are you talking about, Mr Sholmes?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: De quoi parlez-vous ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
Until every one of these <RGB FF6D18>unforgivable felonies</RGB> has
been fully examined in this courtroom...
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Ce dont je parle, mes chers, c'est que jusqu'à ce que les sept
<RGB FF6D18>impardonnables péchés</RGB> de l'accusé ne soient jugés...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
...I shall not step down from this bench!
THAT's what I'm talking about, my dear fellows!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Je n'ai aucunement l'intention de quitter le banc
de l'accusation !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
You do realise...that's the prosecution counsel's
bench, don't you?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: À ce propos...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I don't believe you should have stepped up to it
in the first place.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Ce banc est réservé aux procureurs...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: Thank you, Counsels.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Bref...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: Now, let us hear the charge brought by the prosecution.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Écoutons les propos de l'accusation.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
As I said, there are <RGB FF6D18>seven charges</RGB> against the accused,
to be heard in <RGB FF6D18>seven consecutive trials</RGB> this week.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Au cours des <RGB FF6D18>sept prochaines nuits</RGB>...
nous jugerons les <RGB FF6D18>sept péchés</RGB> commis par l'accusé.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
This evening, we examine the first of those charges –
a most disturbing <RGB FF6D18>crime</RGB>.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Ce soir, nous ouvrirons le bal avec le plus faramineux
de ces <RGB FF6D18>péchés</RGB>...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
What crime?!
Of what does Mr Naruhodo stand accused?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Mais ! Quel péché M. Nick a-t-il bien pu commettre ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
Of <RGB FF6D18>leaking information</RGB>, Miss Susato...
as you well know.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Le péché du <RGB FF6D18>spoiler</RGB>...
Évidemment.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: Huh?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Eh ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: Leaking...information...?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Spoï... leur... vous dites ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I still remember it clearly. The words out of the
accused's mouth last night at the restaurant.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Je m'en souviens très clairement. Les faits remontent à
hier, alors que je discutais avec l'accusé au restaurant.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
The topic of conversation turned to The Great Ace
Attorney, to be released next week.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
C'est alors qu'est venu le sujet de la sortie imminente
de "A Great Era"... Vous en rappelez-vous ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
You recall, I presume, what blurted from your lips
with no regard for the public setting?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Vous rappelez-vous des propos que vous avez tenus
à haute voix, comme si le monde autour de vous n'existait pas ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: Um...well, I think it was something like:
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Eh bien, ça devait être...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
‘I can't believe <RGB FF6D18>The Great Ace Attorney</RGB>
goes on sale next week!’
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
"Enfin !
<RGB FF6D18>A Great Era</RGB> sort la semaine prochaine !"

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
‘I can't wait to see what <RGB FF6D18>curious deductions</RGB>
Mr Sholmes comes out with this time!’
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
"J'ai hâte de voir quelle <RGB FF6D18>déduction déjantée</RGB> M. Holmes
pourra bien nous sortir !"

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
Precisely! There you have it!
My gripe in a nutshell!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Là ! Ce sont ces propos-là qui ne me reviennent pas !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
This great detective's appearance in the title was
supposed to be a great secret. A surreptitious surprise.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Ma présence dans "A Great Era" devait être gardée
sous silence !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I didn't want it to be common knowledge, shared with
all and sundry.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
C'était le plus secret des secrets qu'il ne fallait
absolument jamais divulguer avant la sortie du jeu.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
To speak of it so openly and indiscreetly...
Upon my word, there can be no more repugnant crime!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Je vous assure qu'il n'existe aucun crime plus odieux
que celui de parler de tels sujets en public !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: Really?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Eh.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
‘<RGB FF6D18>Mr Sholmes</RGB>’, ‘<RGB FF6D18>curious deductions</RGB>’...
Both undeniable <RGB FF6D18>spoilers</RGB>!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>M. Holmes</RGB>"... "<RGB FF6D18>Déductions déjantées</RGB>"
Ce sont là des spoilers exemplaires.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Un instant !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I think it's reasonable to say that Mr Naruhodo's words
were simply ‘<RGB FF6D18>information</RGB>’, not ‘<RGB FF6D18>spoilers</RGB>’.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Il ne s'agit là que d'<RGB FF6D18>informations</RGB>, pas des spoilers.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
And I do believe that your appearance, Mr Sholmes, is
already highly anticipated.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
De plus, l'apparition de M. Holmes avait déjà été rendue
publique !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
In fact, that alone may account for many people's interest
in the title.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Il s'agit d'ailleurs de la raison de l'intérêt de certains
pour ce titre.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
Of all the words I'd use to describe your appearance,
‘surreptitious’ isn't one of them.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Et surtout, votre apparition n'a jamais
été un secret...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
I wonder if perhaps your real gripe is with the
description of your deductions as ‘curious’?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Peut être votre problème a-t-il plus à voir avec
le mot "déjanté" ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB><CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB><CNTR>

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
You fail to see the seriousness of the crime...
my learned friend, Miss Susato!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Votre naïveté vous perdra,
Maître Miss Amimo !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
You believe it to be a trifle. But in the world of
mystery, there is nothing so important as trifles.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Dans un monde empli de mystères, même la plus simple
des informations est cruciale, n'est-il pas ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>The accused, Ryunosuke Naruhodo, has committed
<RGB FF6D18>the wilful and callous act of revealing spoilers</RGB>...</CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Les charges retenues contre l'accusé, Hikari Yûno, sont :
"<RGB FF6D18>Un spoiler maladroit et malvenu</RGB>".</CNTR>

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
...for which the prosecution seeks the harshest of
sentences!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
L'accusation demande...
La peine de mort !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: In summary then, the court must decide the following:
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Ce soir, les jurés devront débattre de la question
suivante.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
In the context of a tale of <RGB FF6D18>mystery</RGB>, in which every
<RGB FF6D18>leaked detail</RGB> could be of significance...
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Dans une histoire où toute information est à même de
devenir un "<RGB FF6D18>spoiler</RGB>"...

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
...is it, or is it not, a crime to utter in public that
which has already been <RGB FF6D18>made public</RGB>?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Est-ce mal de divulguer des informations <RGB FF6D18>déjà</RGB>
<RGB FF6D18>rendues publiques</RGB> ?

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
All people have a right to knowledge, naturally.
But they also have a right to ignorance.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Les Hommes ont le droit de savoir, mais surtout, celui
de ne pas savoir.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
The prosecution has called for strict penal action.
We shall reconvene at <RGB FF6D18>five</RGB> tomorrow for adjudication.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Nous retenons la demande de peine de mort par l'accusation.
La sentence sera rendue demain à <RGB FF6D18>17 heures</RGB>.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
The defendant, Ryunosuke Naruhodo's fate is now in
the hands of you, ladies and gentlemen of the jury.
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
Le destin de l'accusé, Hikari Yûno, repose sur les voix
de vous autres, membres du jury.

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
Do you find him <RGB FF6D18>guilty</RGB> or <RGB FF6D18>innocent</RGB>?
What say you, juror?
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>Coupable</RGB>" ou "<RGB FF6D18>Non coupable</RGB>" ?
Nous attendons les votes de tout le monde !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en:
Until tomorrow evening then!
Please deliberate carefully!
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: Sur ce, nous nous retrouverons demain soir !

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>HELP MEEEEEEEEEEEE!</CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À l'aiiiiiiide !</CNTR>

special_movie02_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>To be continued...</CNTR>
special_movie02_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À suivre</CNTR>

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>3rd July, 5:00 p.m.
The Old Bailey Courtroom</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>3 juillet, 17h
Tribunal de Old Bailey</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
The jury has reached a decision about the first charge
brought against Ryunosuke Naruhodo.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Je vais à présent rendre le jugement pour
la première nuit.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Does the defence wish to make a closing statement?
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Avez-vous des objections à faire
avant que la sentence ne tombe ?

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
Myself and my client are very much opposed to the leaking
of information, My Lord. However...
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Mon client et moi-même vouons une haine aux spoilers.
Seulement...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
...A few minor spoilers can't really hurt, surely?
I mean, just the fact that Mr Sholmes will appear is–
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
C'est pas bien grave ! Votre présence dans le jeu,
c'est qu'un petit spoiler de rien du tout...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
‘A few minor spoilers’ you say?
You fail to grasp the magnitude of the situation.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
"De rien du tout" ?
Ce sont là les mots qui précèdent tout grave spoiler.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
The appearance of this great detective...can never
be described as ‘minor’, Mr Naruhodo!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
La présence d'un grand détective tel que moi...
N'a rien d'un "petit détail" !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
The prosecution's last statement – and entire argument –
is completely <RGB FF6D18>inconsistent</RGB>!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Vos propos à l'instant...
sont parfaitement <RGB FF6D18>contradictoires</RGB> !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: I, I beg your pardon?
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: P-Pardon ?

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
If, as you say, you wish to keep the news of your
appearance a secret, Mr Sholmes...
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Si vous teniez vraiment à garder secrète votre apparition,
comme vous le dites...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
...then standing for the prosecution in this public
trial as you are...
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Votre présence même dans cette salle d'audience...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: That very act is surely a ‘<RGB FF6D18>spoiler</RGB>’ in itself!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Ne constitue-t-elle pas elle-même un "<RGB FF6D18>spoiler</RGB>" ?!

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
...I couldn't deny that isn't a possibility that
doesn't make some logical sense.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Je n'ai aucune intention de ne pas dire que votre raisonnement
n'est pas illogique.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
Very well. Ladies and gentlemen of the jury, state your
leanings for the court!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Mesdames et messieurs les jurés, veuillez
à présent rendre votre jugement.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Well, it would appear that the matter is settled, then.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Les jurés semblent s'être décidés.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Seven-day sinner Ryunosuke Naruhodo...
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Pécheur, Hikari Yûno.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>...on this occasion, the court finds you...</CNTR>
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>Ce soir, vous êtes jugé...</CNTR>

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>...<RGB FF6D18>not guilty</RGB>!</CNTR>
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Non coupable</RGB> !</CNTR>

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
Dear me. Not the conclusion I would have expected from
a logical and reasonable jury, I must say.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Eh ben. Je ne pensais pas que de si vénérables jurés
en viendraient à cette conclusion.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: Thank you very much!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Merci beaucoup !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Un instant !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: I happen to know of a certain gentleman...
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Je connais un homme...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
...who was thoroughly estranged as a result of revealing
‘a few minor spoilers’.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Qui a perdu tous ses amis à un cause d'un "petit spoiler
de rien du tout".

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: You do?
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Eh...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
Yes, I know your kind only too well.
You're the sort of person...
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Vous faites assurément partie de ces gens.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
...who would blithely say to someone new to the Herlock
Sholmes stories:
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Ceux qui disent aux gens voulant lire les livres
de Sherlock Holmes...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
‘Sholmes, you say? Oh yes, wasn't he the man who dies
in the end when he plummets from a cliff?’
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
"Holmes ? Ah oui, c'est pas le type qui s'est jeté
du haut d'un immeuble ?"

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: And suchlike.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Ou encore !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
‘But then later on, it turns out that he didn't
actually die at all!’
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: "Mais il est pas vraiment mort, si je me souviens bien."

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: And so on.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Et bien d'autres.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
He's right, there should really have been a spoiler alert
at the start of this trial.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Vous vous êtes mis à spoiler tout le monde, M. Holmes...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: But I'm sure the details aren't quite right...
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Et étrangement, j'ai l'impression que tout ce qu'il
dit est faux...

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
I hereby call an end to this, the first of the defendant's
trials this week.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
La première séance pour le jugement de Hikari Yûno
est levée !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: I trust you shall all attend the next trial.
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: Venez assister nombreux au procès de demain.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
Hopefully it will go as well as today,
and Mr Naruhodo will be acquitted again!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Je continuerai à me surpasser ! Je deviendrai
la meilleure des avocates !

special_movie03_Message_eng.en:
That is all. Court is adjourned until the <RGB FF6D18>second</RGB> trial
tomorrow evening!
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr:
Au revoir. Le procès reprendra pour
la <RGB FF6D18>deuxième</RGB> nuit.

special_movie03_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>To be continued...</CNTR>
special_movie03_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À suivre</CNTR>

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>Ryunosuke Naruhodo's Seven Days of Sin
Evening of Day Two</CNTR>
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Hikari Yûno dans
Les sept nuits du péché - 2e nuit</CNTR>

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>3rd July, 5:00 p.m.
The Old Bailey Courtroom</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>3 juillet, 17h
Tribunal de Old Bailey</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
I hereby call to order this trial of the defendant,
<RGB FF6D18>Ryunosuke Naruhodo</RGB>.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: Je déclare le procès de <RGB FF6D18>Hikari Yûno</RGB> ouvert.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
Are the counsels for the prosecution and defence
ready to proceed with this <RGB FF6D18>second trial</RGB>?
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Nous voici arrivés à la <RGB FF6D18>deuxième nuit</RGB>.
Tout le monde est-il prêt ?

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Kazuma Asogi</RGB> for the defence, My Lord.
Yes, I'm ready.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Kiyô Norasompéï</RGB>, avocat de la défense.
Prêt, Votre Honneur.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Herlock Sholmes</RGB> for the prosecution, My Lord.
As ever, in complete and utter readiness.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Sherlock Holmes</RGB> pour l'accusation.
Prêt, naturellement.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: And I, as ever...am in complete and utter unreadiness.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: ... Toujours pas prêt, naturellement.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
What is it this time?
I really have no idea what I'm supposed to have done!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Qu'est-ce que vous me reprochez, cette fois ?!
J'ai rien fait !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
The crime of which you stand accused tonight, my
dear fellow...is that of <RGB FF6D18>dishonouring a lady</RGB>!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Le péché que nous jugerons ce soir est...
celui d'<RGB FF6D18>affront</RGB> à la <RGB FF6D18>gent féminine</RGB> !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: <RGB FF6D18>Dishonouring</RGB>...?
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: Un "<RGB FF6D18>affront</RGB>" ?

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: A, <RGB FF6D18>a lady</RGB>?!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: La "<RGB FF6D18>gent féminine</RGB>" ?

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: Indeed. The accused's judicial assistant, in fact.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Je parle évidemment de votre assistante juridique.
Cette jeune fille.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: <RGB FF6D18>Judicial Assistant Mikotoba</RGB>?
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: <RGB FF6D18>Amimo Amiéyama</RGB> ?

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
I still remember it clearly. The words out of the
accused's mouth last night at the restaurant.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Je m'en souviens clairement. Hier, lors d'un repas
partagé avec tout le monde au restaurant.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
As the lady in question arose from her seat to leave,
he noticed she had forgotten her purse.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Cette jeune femme allait se lever, le portefeuille oublié
sur la table. L'accusé l'appela donc d'une voix paniquée.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
You recall, I presume, what blurted from your lips,
Mr Naruhodo?
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: Évidemment, vous n'avez pas oublié ce que vous avez dit ?

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: Um...well yes, I think it was something like:
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: Non, j'ai dû dire quelque chose comme...

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: ‘Oh! That looks like Susato-san's purse.’
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: "Ça serait pas ton portefeuille, Amimo ?"

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
‘I, I think you're forgetting something, <RGB FF6D18>Sasato-san</RGB>!
<RGB FF6D18>Susas-san</RGB>! I mean, <RGB FF6D18>Susat-tsuan</RGB>...’
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: "Attends ! <RGB FF6D18>Amomi</RGB> ! <RGB FF6D18>Mimoma</RGB> ! <RGB FF6D18>Mamimo</RGB>"

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
The accused insulted the lady by <RGB FF6D18>mispronouncing her
name</RGB>...not once, but <RGB FF6D18>three times</RGB>!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
L'accusé a <RGB FF6D18>mal prononcé</RGB> le nom de son assistante !
Et ce, <RGB FF6D18>trois fois</RGB> de suite !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Un instant !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
Yes, certainly, to call one's own judicial assistant
by the wrong name is a graceless blunder, but–
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Certes, je conçois qu'il est impoli de mal prononcer le nom
de sa propre assistante, mais...

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
No buts, my learned friend! For that third attempt
of ‘<RGB FF6D18>Susat-tsuan</RGB>’...
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
De plus, j'attire votre attention sur la troisième
erreur, "<RGB FF6D18>Momami</RGB>".

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: ...was perilously close to ‘Su's Hat Swan’!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Encore une erreur et l'accusé
appelait son assistante "Moman" !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: GAAAAAAAAARGH!!!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: Haaaaaaa !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
Just try it for yourself! Try to say that name
<RGB FF6D18>three times in a row</RGB> and see how you get on!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Attendez ! Essayez seulement de prononcer 
<RGB FF6D18>trois fois</RGB> son nom très vite !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
You'll quickly find out that it's harder than your
average tongue twister.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Vous comprendrez alors à quel point il est facile
de se tromper !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
The truth is...names that look prettiest on paper are
<RGB FF6D18>a death trap</RGB> for the mouth!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Ce nom en apparence magnifique n'est autre
qu'un <RGB FF6D18>piège</RGB> !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>The accused has <RGB FF6D18>wrought great disgrace</RGB> with an
ill-fated twist of the tongue...</CNTR>
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Les charges retenues contre l'accusé Hikari Yûno sont :
"<RGB FF6D18>Un affront causé par une articulation douteuse</RGB>".

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
...for which the prosecution seeks the harshest of
sentences!
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
L'accusation demande...
La peine de mort !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: In summary then, the court must decide the following:
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Ce soir, les jurés devront débattre de la question
suivante.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
Is failing to say ‘<RGB FF6D18>Susato-san</RGB>’ correctly <RGB FF6D18>three times</RGB>
<RGB FF6D18>in rapid succession</RGB>...
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
L'accusé n'a pas réussi à prononcer correctement le
nom "<RGB FF6D18>Amimo</RGB>", même après <RGB FF6D18>trois</RGB> essais.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
...<RGB FF6D18>a crime</RGB> worthy of punishment, or merely a result
of <RGB FF6D18>a punishing name</RGB> for the tongue?
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Est-ce que c'est "<RGB FF6D18>mal</RGB>" ou
juste une <RGB FF6D18>erreur naturelle</RGB> ?

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
The most beautiful names have a right to be
pronounced beautifully.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Un nom aussi distingué que celui-ci mérite
une prononciation toute aussi distinguée.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
The prosecution has called for strict penal action.
We shall reconvene at <RGB FF6D18>five</RGB> tomorrow for adjudication.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Nous retenons la demande de peine de mort par l'accusation.
La sentence sera rendue demain à <RGB FF6D18>17 heures</RGB>.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
The defendant, Ryunosuke Naruhodo's fate is now in
the hands of you, ladies and gentlemen of the jury.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Le destin de l'accusé, Hikari Yûno, repose sur les voix
de vous autres, membres du jury.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
Do you find him <RGB FF6D18>guilty</RGB> or <RGB FF6D18>innocent</RGB>?
What say you, juror?
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>Coupable</RGB>" ou "<RGB FF6D18>Non coupable</RGB>" ?
Nous attendons les votes de tout le monde !

special_movie04_Message_eng.en:
Until tomorrow, then, when we'll see how this case
ends.
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr:
Le procès est fini pour ce soir.
Nous nous retrouverons demain.

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>HELP MEEEEEEEEEEEE!</CNTR>
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À l'aiiiiiiide !</CNTR>

special_movie04_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>To be continued...</CNTR>
special_movie04_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À suivre</CNTR>

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>4th July, 5:00 p.m.
The Old Bailey Courtroom</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>4 juillet, 17h
Tribunal de Old Bailey</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
The jury has reached a decision about the second charge
brought against Ryunosuke Naruhodo.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Je vais à présent rendre le jugement pour
la deuxième nuit.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Does the defence wish to make a closing statement?
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Avez-vous des objections à faire
avant que la sentence ne tombe ?

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
It's clear that names with too many ‘<RGB FF6D18>s</RGB>’ sounds next to
each other are very hard to say.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Les allitérations en "<RGB FF6D18>M</RGB>" sont
compliquées à prononcer.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
So if anyone is guilty here, it's whoever conceived of
such a name in the first place!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Si quelqu'un est coupable d'un quelconque péché,
c'est la personne qui lui a donné ce nom !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: I'm afraid that sort of chicanery won't help you here.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Les excuses ne vous sauveront pas.
De plus...

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: You see, I've been a step ahead of you from the start.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Mon combat est bien plus ardu que le vôtre.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: W-What do you mean ‘a step ahead’?
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Que voulez-vous dire ?

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
‘<RGB FF6D18>Susato-san</RGB>’ is child's play.
You Japanese have vowels between your esses.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>Amimo</RGB>" est un nom relativement facile à prononcer, pour
vous autres Japonais. Mais ici, nous l'appelons...

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
But we Englishmen stare the devil in the face with
a fiendish <RGB FF6D18>triple ess</RGB> in ‘<RGB FF6D18>Miss Susato</RGB>’!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
"Madame Amimo</RGB>" !
Pas moins de quatre maudits "<RGB FF6D18>M</RGB>" de suite !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: What?!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Q-Quoi... ?!

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
Go ahead, try it...if you dare!
A <RGB FF6D18>rapid-fire triple</RGB> ‘<RGB FF6D18>Miss Susato</RGB>’!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Allez-y ! Essayez !
Dites "<RGB FF6D18>Madame Amimo</RGB>". <RGB FF6D18>Trois fois</RGB>. <RGB FF6D18>Rapidement</RGB> !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
.........
Miss Susus–
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
........
Madamimmo...

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Susato-saaaaaaaaan!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Amimooooooooo !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: A step ahead? That last claim of yours was <RGB FF6D18>a step too far</RGB>!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Vos propos à l'instant...
Nous laissent entrevoir votre véritable nature.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: I beg your pardon?
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Pardon ?

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
Since the beginning of this trial, I've been paying
careful attention to your pronunciation, Mr Sholmes.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Vous vous exprimez de manière singulière depuis
le début du procès.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
And I'd say you've been <RGB FF6D18>doing your utmost</RGB> to avoid saying
the name of the lady in question.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
M. Holmes, vous n'avez jamais <RGB FF6D18>directement </RGB>prononcé
le nom de la demoiselle.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
It's always been ‘<RGB FF6D18>the lady in question</RGB>’ or ‘<RGB FF6D18>your
judicial assistant</RGB>’ or some such. Why? Simple...
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>Cette jeune femme</RGB>", "<RGB FF6D18>votre assistante</RGB>"...
Et ce pour une seule raison...

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
Because you know that you're very likely to dishonour
the lady by <RGB FF6D18>mispronouncing her name</RGB> yourself!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Vous savez très bien que votre langue pourrait
<RGB FF6D18>fourcher</RGB> à tout instant !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
...I couldn't deny that that isn't something about which
I haven't been not even slightly worried.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Je n'ai aucune intention de ne pas dire que ce
que vous venez de dire n'est pas incorrect.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
Very well. Ladies and gentlemen of the jury, state your
leanings for the court!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Mesdames et messieurs les jurés, veuillez
à présent rendre votre jugement.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Non coupable !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Well, it would appear that the matter is settled, then.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Les jurés semblent s'être décidés.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Seven-day sinner Ryunosuke Naruhodo...
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Pécheur, Hikari Yûno.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>...on this occasion, the court finds you...</CNTR>
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>Ce soir, vous êtes jugé...</CNTR>

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>...<RGB FF6D18>not guilty</RGB>!</CNTR>
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Non coupable</RGB> !</CNTR>

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
Dear me. Not the conclusion I would have expected from
a logical and reasonable jury, I must say.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Eh ben. Je ne pensais pas que de si vénérables jurés
en viendraient à cette conclusion.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: Thank you very much!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Merci beaucoup !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
I hereby call an end to this, the second of the defendant's
trials this week.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
La deuxième séance pour le jugement de Hikari Yûno
est levée !

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: I trust you shall all attend the next trial.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Venez assister nombreux au procès de demain.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en: It looks as though my job here is done, partner.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: On dirait que j'ai réussi à te tirer d'affaire, mon ami.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
Thanks, Kazuma. I'll treat Susato-san to something sweet
to say sorry.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Merci, j'achèterai une pâtisserie pour Amimo en rentrant.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
Good idea. I'm sure Judicial Assistant Mikotoba
would be touched.
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: Bonne idée, je suis sûr que qu'elle en sera ravie.

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
<RGB 18D7FA>(You're trying to avoid saying it too, aren't you?
<RGB FF6D18>The lady in question's name</RGB>...)</RGB>
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr: (Toi aussi, t'évites de prononcer son nom...)

special_movie05_Message_eng.en:
That is all. Court is adjourned until the <RGB FF6D18>third</RGB> trial
tomorrow evening!
special_movie05_Message_eng.fr:
Au revoir. Le procès reprendra pour
la <RGB FF6D18>troisième</RGB> nuit.
