special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>Ryunosuke Naruhodo's Seven Days of Sin
Evening of Day Three</CNTR>
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Hikari Yûno dans
Les sept nuits du péché - 3e nuit</CNTR>

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>4th July, 5:00 p.m.
The Old Bailey Courtroom</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>4 juillet, 17h
Tribunal de Old Bailey</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
I hereby call to order this trial of the defendant,
Ryunosuke Naruhodo.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Je déclare le procès de <RGB FF6D18>Hikari Yûno</RGB> ouvert.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Are the counsels for the prosecution and defence
ready to proceed with this <RGB FF6D18>third</RGB> trial?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Nous voici arrivés à la <RGB FF6D18>troisième nuit</RGB>.
Tout le monde est-il prêt ?

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Iris Wilson</RGB> for the defence.
I'm ready for anything, My Lord!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Iris Watson</RGB> à la défense !
Prête, Votre Honneur !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Herlock Sholmes</RGB> for the prosecution, My Lord.
As ever, in complete and utter readiness.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Sherlock Holmes</RGB> à l'accusation.
Prêt, naturellement.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: And I, as ever...am completely unprepared.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Pas besoin de le dire, mais moi,
je suis toujours pas prêt.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
This is getting ridiculous! Night after night,
my name being dragged through the mud...
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Laissez-moi tranquille !
Arrêtez de me traiter comme un criminel...

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
And this night, you stand accused of <RGB FF6D18>overindulgence</RGB>.
You recall, I presume, the incident in question?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Ce soir, nous jugerons le crime de <RGB FF6D18>surmenage</RGB>.
Vous n'avez pas oublié, j'imagine.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Of course I don't recall it!
I've never even heard of overindulgence as a crime!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Vous imaginez mal ! J'ai tout oublié !
Je ne savais même pas que ça existait !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
And yet you've perfectly illustrated my point
with that bellicose ‘<RGB FF6D18>objection</RGB>’!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Précisément ! Le problème est le suivant...
"<RGB FF6D18>Objection</RGB> !"

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: Here we go...
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Hein ? Quoi ?

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Un instant !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
The defence demands that Hurley explains what he's
talking about!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
La défense demande une explication de la part
de Sherlockinou !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: Erm...perhaps before that...
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Dites, avant de poursuivre...

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
...we might be able to bring the defence up to a
slightly higher level?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Vous ne voudriez pas donner
un peu de hauteur à la défense ?

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
An excellent suggestion. Pray, where are the potato
crates kept in this courtroom?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Sans problème. Qu'on lui apporte une caisse à patate !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: Ooh, what a good view I have from up here!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Oooh ! Je peux voir ma maison d'ici !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Ah, and what a charming young lawyer we had hiding
in the courtroom.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Ooh ! Quelle avocate à croquer.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: Hee hee!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Héhé !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
The accused will of course be aware of the name
<RGB FF6D18>Hiro Shimono</RGB>.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Accusé, je présume que le nom "<RGB FF6D18>Hiro Shimono</RGB>"
ne vous est pas étranger ?

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: Huh? Oh, well, um...
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Eh ! Et bien, je...

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Oh yes! The lovely <RGB FF6D18>Japanese voice actor</RGB> who
reads all Runo's lines!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Ah ! Tu veux parler du <RGB FF6D18>comédien de doublage</RGB> qui prête
sa voix à Nicky !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: Voice actor...? You're blaming me for that now?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Mon doubleur... Vous cherchez la petite bête, là...

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
I refer of course to the studio recording of your
‘objection’ line. You remember the occasion?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Souvenez-vous du studio d'enregistrement.
Du doublage de l'<RGB FF6D18>objection</RGB>.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Tell the court, <RGB FF6D18>how many takes</RGB> did you demand for the
nebulous reason of being ‘<RGB FF6D18>dissatisfied</RGB>’?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Du <RGB FF6D18>nombres de prises</RGB> qu'il a fallu refaire
à cause de raisons douteuses comme : "<RGB FF6D18>Pas assez satisfaisante</RGB>".

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Erm...I don't actually remember, but I imagine it was
rather a lot?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Eh bien... Je suis pas certain du nombre exact, mais
je sais que c'était beaucoup...

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Sixteen</RGB> takes! On that one little phrase! Without sparing
a single thought for Mr Shimono's vocal chords.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>16 prises</RGB> ! Pour l'enregistrement de l'objection,
vous avez fait crier M. Shimono pas moins de 16 fois.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: Good gracious!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Ooooh...
Juste ciel !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Good gracious indeed, My Lord.
But that is not all.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Et ce n'est pas tout.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
The following day, for reasons best known only to the
accused, ‘<RGB FF6D18>dissatisfaction</RGB>’ struck again!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Parce qu'il "<RGB FF6D18>manquait un je ne sais quoi</RGB>", M. Shimano
a dû revenir au studio un autre jour.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
The tireless Mr Shimono had to perform a further <RGB FF6D18>twelve</RGB>
takes of the phrase.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Cette fois, pour crier "objection" <RGB FF6D18>12</RGB> fois de plus.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Despite the fact that only a single ‘objection’ soundbite
is used in the game!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Alors qu'une seule de ces prises est utilisée en jeu !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: GAAAAAAAAAAAARGH!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Ghaaaaaaa !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>The accused, Ryunosuke Naruhodo, is charged with
<RGB FF6D18>objectionable overindulgence of Mr Shimono's vocal chords</RGB>...</CNTR>
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Les charges retenue contre l'accusé Hikari Yûno sont :
"<RGB FF6D18>Un enfer d'objections pour Hiro Himono</RGB>".</CNTR>

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
...for which the prosecution seeks the harshest of
sentences!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
L'accusation demande...
La peine capitale !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: In summary then, the court must decide the following:
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Ce soir, les jurés devront débattre de la question
suivante.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Is <RGB FF6D18>twenty-eight</RGB> takes of ‘objection’ indicative of
<RGB FF6D18>pernicketiness</RGB> or <RGB FF6D18>perfectionism</RGB>?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Faire répéter 28 fois une prise relève-t-il
de "<RGB FF6D18>l'attention</RGB>" ou du "<RGB FF6D18>surmenage</RGB>" ?

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
No doubt the final ‘objection’ was an expression of
Mr Shimono's true feelings on the matter.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Le 28e cri venait du fond du cœur, assurément.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: Hmmm...
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Nghnnnn...

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
...you could be on to something, Hurley.
<RGB FF6D18>Guilty</RGB> as charged, I think.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
C'est pas faux.
Nicky est clairement déjà "<RGB FF6D18>coupable</RGB>" !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Iris! Isn't a defence lawyer supposed to side with the
defendant...?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: Iris ! Un avocat est censé défendre son client...

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
The prosecution has called for strict penal action.
We shall reconvene at <RGB FF6D18>five</RGB> tomorrow for adjudication.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Nous retenons la demande de peine de mort par l'accusation.
La sentence sera rendue demain à <RGB FF6D18>17 heures</RGB>.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
The defendant, Ryunosuke Naruhodo's fate is now in
the hands of you, ladies and gentlemen of the jury.
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Le destin de l'accusé, Hikari Yûno, repose sur les voix
de vous autres, membres du jury.

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
Do you find him <RGB FF6D18>guilty</RGB> or <RGB FF6D18>innocent</RGB>?
What say you, juror?
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>Coupable</RGB>" ou "<RGB FF6D18>Non coupable</RGB>" ?
Nous attendons les votes de tout le monde !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en:
I need to go and cook dinner now, so I'll see you
all tomorrow! Bye!
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr:
Je dois aller préparer à manger.
À demain tout le monde !

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>HELP MEEEEEEEEEEEE!</CNTR>
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À l'aiiiiiiide !</CNTR>

special_movie06_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>To be continued...</CNTR>
special_movie06_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À suivre</CNTR>

special_movie07_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>5th July, 5:00 p.m.
The Old Bailey Courtroom</RGB></CNTR>

The jury has reached a decision about the third charge
brought against Ryunosuke Naruhodo.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
Je vais à présent rendre le jugement pour
la troisième nuit.

special_movie07_Message_eng.en: Does the defence wish to make a closing statement?
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
Avez-vous des objections à faire
avant que la sentence ne tombe ?

special_movie07_Message_eng.en:
Well! The defence has been making some enquiries and
discovered vital evidence!
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
La défense a effectué des recherches approfondies
sur toute l'affaire !

special_movie07_Message_eng.en: You, you have, Iris?!

Well well...most intriguing.
Something relevant to this case?
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
Ça alors. As-tu déniché quoi que ce soit
d'intéressant ?

special_movie07_Message_eng.en:
Oh yes! Very relevant!
It's all here in this file.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr: Oui ! J'ai trouvé une super nouvelle information !

special_movie07_Message_eng.en:
As you said yesterday, Hurley, poor Mr Shimono had
to perform that ‘<RGB FF6D18>objection</RGB>’ twenty-eight times in total.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr: Monsieur Shimonou à dû crier l'<RGB FF6D18>objection</RGB> 28 fois...

special_movie07_Message_eng.en:
But it turns out that the take that was actually used
in the end...was <RGB FF6D18>the very first one</RGB>!
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
Mais la prise qui à été utilisée dans le jeu c'est...
<RGB FF6D18>La toute première</RGB> !

special_movie07_Message_eng.en: ...What a cruel taskmaster.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr: Que le monde du doublage peut être cruel !

special_movie07_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
You're right, Iris, that was <RGB FF6D18>new information</RGB>.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr: Iris, c'est vrai que cette information est nouvelle, mais...

special_movie07_Message_eng.en: But did you really need to share it with the court?
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
Tu crois vraiment que c'est le bon moment pour la
présenter ?!

special_movie07_Message_eng.en:
It may interest you to know that the ‘objection’ we
just heard...was <RGB FF6D18>take number twenty-three</RGB>.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
D'ailleurs, l'objection que vous venez d'entendre...
est la <RGB FF6D18>prise n°23</RGB> !

special_movie07_Message_eng.en:
F... F...
FORGIVE MEEEEEEEEEEEE!

So, pray tell the court, ladies and gentlemen of the
jury: how do you find the accused?
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
Mesdames et messieurs les jurés, veuillez
à présent rendre votre jugement.

special_movie07_Message_eng.en: Guilty!
Guilty!
Guilty!
Guilty!
Guilty!
Guilty!

It would appear that the jurors are unanimous in
their decision.
Seven-day sinner Ryunosuke Naruhodo...
<CNTR>...on this occasion, the court finds you...</CNTR>
<CNTR>...<RGB FF6D18>guilty</RGB>!</CNTR>

An unsurprising result. The worldly ladies and gentlemen
of the jury are great allies of mine.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
Il fallait s'y attendre, les jurés du monde entier
sont mes alliés.

special_movie07_Message_eng.en: UWAAAAAAAAAAAARGH!

I hereby call an end to this, the third of the defendant's
trials this week.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
La troisième séance pour le jugement de Hikari Yûno
est levée !

special_movie07_Message_eng.en: I trust you shall all attend the next trial.
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr: Venez assister nombreux au procès de demain.

special_movie07_Message_eng.en:
I think you got your just deserts there, Runo,
don't you?

That is all. Court is adjourned until the <RGB FF6D18>fourth</RGB> trial
tomorrow evening!
special_movie07_Message_eng.fr:
Au revoir. Le procès reprendra pour
la <RGB FF6D18>quatrième</RGB> nuit.

special_movie08_Message_eng.en:

special_movie10_Message_eng.fr:
Est-ce bien normal d'avoir les yeux fuyants et les genoux
tremblant lorsque l'on est sous pression ?

special_movie10_Message_eng.en:
I suggest you start looking for more raisins before
all we can see are the whites of your eyes.
special_movie10_Message_eng.fr: Je vous conseille de fuir et de trembler devant mon génie.

special_movie10_Message_eng.en:
The prosecution has called for strict penal action.
We shall reconvene at <RGB FF6D18>five</RGB> tomorrow for adjudication.
special_movie10_Message_eng.fr:
Nous retenons la demande de peine de mort par l'accusation.
La sentence sera rendue demain à <RGB FF6D18>17 heures</RGB>.

special_movie10_Message_eng.en:
The defendant, Ryunosuke Naruhodo's fate is now in
the hands of you, ladies and gentlemen of the jury.
special_movie10_Message_eng.fr:
Le destin de l'accusé, Hikari Yûno, repose sur les voix
de vous autres, membres du jury.

special_movie10_Message_eng.en:
Do you find him <RGB FF6D18>guilty</RGB> or <RGB FF6D18>innocent</RGB>?
What say you, juror?
special_movie10_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>Coupable</RGB>" ou "<RGB FF6D18>Non coupable</RGB>" ?
Nous attendons les votes de tout le monde !

special_movie10_Message_eng.en:
This is a trial that we can't afford to lose.
My reputation as a lawyer is at stake.
special_movie10_Message_eng.fr:
Je ne peux pas perdre ce duel.
Il en va de mon futur en temps qu'avocat...

special_movie10_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>HELP MEEEEEEEEEEEE!</CNTR>
special_movie10_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À l'aiiiiiiide !</CNTR>

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
The jury has reached a decision about the fifth charge
brought against Ryunosuke Naruhodo.
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Je vais à présent rendre le jugement pour
la cinquième nuit.

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Are there any closing statements to be made?
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Avez-vous des objections à faire
avant que la sentence ne tombe ?

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Woefully <RGB FF6D18>wide eyes</RGB> and cacophonic <RGB FF6D18>knocking knees</RGB>...
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Les <RGB FF6D18>yeux fuyants</RGB>, les <RGB FF6D18>genoux tremblants</RGB>...

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
You Japanese have a curious manner. It's almost as if
you wish to draw attention to your foibles.
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Vous autres Japonais adorez vous donner en spectacle.
Un peuple bien singulier.

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: What did you say?
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Pardon ?!

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
It really is quite the most ridiculous thing. At times
I think you're <RGB FF6D18>two plates short of a dinner set</RGB>!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
N'est-ce pas vous autres qui faites concourir vos bébés
dans une compétition du <RGB FF6D18>meilleur pleurnichard</RGB> ?

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
...I presume that's supposed to be some witty British
idiom, is it?
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Vous connaissez même une tradition
aussi rare que celle-ci...

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
Is that the best the world-famous great detective
can do?!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Vous n'avez pas volé votre titre de détective
de renommée mondiale !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Time to hear the court's decision, I think, don't you?
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Bien ! Il est grand temps d'entendre les avis de
nos chers jurés.

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
So, pray tell, ladies and gentlemen of the jury:
how do you find the accused?
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Mesdames et messieurs les jurés, veuillez
à présent rendre votre jugement.

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Guilty!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Coupable !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Guilty!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Coupable !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Guilty!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Coupable !

special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Coupable !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Guilty!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Coupable !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Guilty!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Coupable !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
It would appear that the jurors are unanimous in
their decision.
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Les jurés semblent s'être décidés.

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Seven-day sinner Ryunosuke Naruhodo...
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Pécheur, Hikari Yûno.

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>...on this occasion, the court finds you...</CNTR>
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>Ce soir, vous êtes jugé...</CNTR>

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>...<RGB FF6D18>guilty</RGB>!</CNTR>
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Coupable</RGB> !</CNTR>

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
An unsurprising result. The worldly ladies and gentlemen
of the jury are great allies of mine.
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Il fallait s'y attendre, les jurés du monde entier
sont mes alliés.

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: UWAAAAAAAAAAAARGH!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Whaaaaaaaa !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
I hereby call an end to this, the fifth of the defendant's
trials this week.
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Sur ce, la cinquième séance pour le jugement de Hikari Yûno
est levée !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
Grrr...talking about us Japanese like that...
It's <RGB FF6D18>brazen mockery</RGB>!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
... Quel affront.
Je n'ai rien pu faire...

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: Quite. <RGB FF6D18>Raisin crockery</RGB> indeed!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Si vous souhaitez une revanche, je vous propose
un duel de <RGB FF6D18>larmes</RGB>.

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
But really, there's no need for dried or sour grapes.
Ah ha ha ha ha hah!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
C'est assurément vous, le meilleur pleurnichard !
Ha ha ha ha ha ha !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en: CURSE YOU!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: Aaaaaaaaaaaah !

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
<RGB 18D7FA>(Mr Sholmes should really think about <RGB FF6D18>‘raisin’
the bar</RGB> a bit, I think...)</RGB>
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr: (Kiyô est déjà au bord des larmes...)

special_movie11_Message_eng.en:
That is all. Court is adjourned until the <RGB FF6D18>sixth</RGB> trial
tomorrow evening!
special_movie11_Message_eng.fr:
Au revoir. Le procès reprendra pour
la <RGB FF6D18>sixième</RGB> nuit.

Evening of Day Six</CNTR>

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>7th July, 5:00 p.m.
The Old Bailey Courtroom</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>7 juillet, 17h
Tribunal de Old Bailey</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
I hereby call to order this trial of the defendant,
Ryunosuke Naruhodo.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Je déclare le procès de <RGB FF6D18>Hikari Yûno</RGB> ouvert.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
Are the counsels for the prosecution and defence
ready to proceed with this <RGB FF6D18>sixth</RGB> trial?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Nous voici arrivés à la <RGB FF6D18>sixième</RGB> nuit.
Tout le monde est-il prêt ?

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Iris Wilson</RGB>, My Lord, humbly representing the defence.
I am ready, thank you, yes.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Iris Watson</RGB> à la défense !
Prête, votre Honneur !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Herlock Sholmes</RGB> for the prosecution.
Ready and eager to proceed, My Lord.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Sherlock Holmes</RGB> pour l'accusation.
Prêt, naturellement.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: This dock is starting to feel like my home port now.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Je commencerais presque à me sentir comme chez moi, ici...

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
But how many times do I have to experience this sinking
feeling before you're satisfied?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Combien de fois vous allez me faire venir ici, au juste ?!

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Un instant !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
Indeed! <RGB FF6D18>That very question</RGB> brings us neatly to
<RGB FF6D18>the crime</RGB> of the day!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
C'est précisément "ça", le <RGB FF6D18>péché</RGB> que nous allons
juger ce soir.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: What have you got, Hurley?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: De quoi tu parles, Sherlockinou ?

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
How many times must the accused – or rather the accused
and his defence-lawyering <RGB FF6D18>dynasty</RGB>...
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
J'ai une question pour l'accusé, ou plutôt, pour
sa <RGB FF6D18>lignée</RGB>.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: ...stand accused in <RGB FF6D18>the dock</RGB> before they are satisfied?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Combien de fois allez-vous devoir être <RGB FF6D18>accusés</RGB>
avant d'être pleinement satisfaits ?

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: My defence-lawyering <RGB FF6D18>dynasty</RGB>? What...?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Ma... "<RGB FF6D18>lignée</RGB>" ?

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
You recall, I presume, your future relation by the name
of <RGB FF6D18>Phoenix Wright</RGB>?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
N'y aurait-t-il pas un certain avocat prénommé "<RGB FF6D18>Phoenix</RGB>"
parmi vos descendants ?

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
.........
I can't say the name rings a bell, no.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
............
Je sais même plus quoi répondre...

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
He, like you, is – or will be – a defence lawyer
destined for the dock <RGB FF6D18>twice</RGB>!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Cet autre avocat serait déjà passé <RGB FF6D18>deux fois</RGB> devant un juge.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
No doubt his fate was predetermined by yours...which
has seen you charged with <RGB FF6D18>seven</RGB> crimes already.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Et vous, son ancêtre, êtes apparu en justice pas moins
de <RGB FF6D18>sept fois</RGB> déjà.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
Between the pair of you, therefore, that's a total of <RGB FF6D18>nine</RGB>
court appearances as the accused!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Soit un total de <RGB FF6D18>neuf fois</RGB> à vous deux.
Votre famille doit être abonnée au banc des accusés !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Hold it!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Un instant !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
One of those seven times isn't even part of <RGB FF6D18>the game</RGB>,
Hurley. It's in <RGB FF6D18>an escape room event</RGB>.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Attendez ! Une des ces sept fois n'était pas en <RGB FF6D18>jeu</RGB> mais
dans un <RGB FF6D18>escape game</RGB> !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: <RGB FF6D18>An event</RGB>? Pray, what do you mean, Iris?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Un "<RGB FF6D18>escape game</RGB>"... ?

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
Haven't you heard of it? ‘<RGB FF6D18>Murder at the Old Bailey</RGB>’.
It's been <RGB FF6D18>hugely popular</RGB> up and down the country!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>Le meurtre de l'Old Bailey</RGB>" !
<RGB FF6D18>Populaire</RGB> à travers tout le pays !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
Well, I'm delighted the public enjoys seeing Mr Naruhodo
sweat as much as I.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Ça m'a tout l'air passionnant, dites donc.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
And <RGB FF6D18>five</RGB> of the seven appearances are <RGB FF6D18>the five trials</RGB>
I've had to endure this week!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Et puis ! Les <RGB FF6D18>cinq</RGB> autres <RGB FF6D18>fois</RGB> ont eu
lieu ces <RGB FF6D18>cinq</RGB> derniers jours</RGB>, de votre faute !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: None of these have anything to do with the game at all!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Ça n'a rien à voir avec le vrai jeu !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: Hm, nevertheless...
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Peu importe.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
...it's a poor protagonist who's so <RGB FF6D18>closely acquainted</RGB>
with the dock even before his adventures go on sale.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Quel genre de protagoniste serait autant <RGB FF6D18>accointé</RGB> avec
le banc des accusés juste avant la sortie de son propre jeu ?

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: Uuugh...
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Ghg...

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: If this trend continues, one can only presume...
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Si vous continuez sur cette voie...

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
...that great tribulations as well as trials await in
the game itself!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Vous serez assurément confronté à une terrible destinée.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: AAAAAAAAAAAAGH!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Ghaaaaaa !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>The accused, Ryunosuke Naruhodo, is charged with
<RGB FF6D18>excessive appearances of his dynasty in the dock</RGB>...</CNTR>
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Les charges retenues contre l'accusé Hikari Yûno sont :
"<RGB FF6D18>Une lignée trop souvent trainée en justice</RGB>".</CNTR>

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
...for which the prosecution seeks the harshest of
sentences!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
L'accusation demande...
La peine de mort !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: In summary then, the court must decide the following:
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Ce soir, les jurés devront débattre de la question
suivante.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
For members of <RGB FF6D18>the Naruhodo clan</RGB>, whose role as
<RGB FF6D18>protagonists</RGB> in these tales is to uphold justice...
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Bien que Hikari et Phoenix soient tout deux les protagonistes
de jeux ayant pour thème la justice...

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
...is a total of <RGB FF6D18>nine</RGB> appearances in the dock <RGB FF6D18>unsurprising</RGB>
or <RGB FF6D18>unforgivable</RGB>?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Ils ont été jugés <RGB FF6D18>neuf fois</RGB> à eux deux.
Ce nombre est-il <RGB FF6D18>trop élevé</RGB> ?

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
I have little doubt that the number will continue to
increase. As early as tomorrow evening, in fact.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Dès demain, ce chiffre sera déjà obsolète.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: ...I'll look forward to that.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Je me demande à cause de qui...

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
The prosecution has called for strict penal action.
We shall reconvene at <RGB FF6D18>five</RGB> tomorrow for adjudication.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Nous retenons la demande de peine de mort par l'accusation.
La sentence sera rendue demain à <RGB FF6D18>17 heures</RGB>.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
The defendant, Ryunosuke Naruhodo's fate is now in
the hands of you, ladies and gentlemen of the jury.
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
Le destin de l'accusé, Hikari Yûno, repose sur les voix
de vous autres, membres du jury.

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
Do you find him <RGB FF6D18>guilty</RGB> or <RGB FF6D18>innocent</RGB>?
What say you, juror?
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr:
"<RGB FF6D18>Coupable</RGB>" ou "<RGB FF6D18>Non coupable</RGB>" ?
Nous attendons les votes de tout le monde !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en:
It is exciting, though, isn't it?
Wondering if Runo will be convicted or not!
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: Ça doit être palpitant d'être accusé !

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>HELP MEEEEEEEEEEEE!</CNTR>
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À l'aiiiiiiide !</CNTR>

special_movie12_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>To be continued...</CNTR>
special_movie12_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À suivre</CNTR>

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR><RGB 80FB0A>8th July, 5:00 p.m.
The Old Bailey Courtroom</RGB></CNTR>

The jury has reached a decision about the sixth charge
brought against Ryunosuke Naruhodo.
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Je vais à présent rendre le jugement pour
la sixième nuit.

special_movie13_Message_eng.en: Are there any closing statements?
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Avez-vous des objections à faire
avant que la sentence ne tombe ?

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
The prosecution acknowledges the recent rise in
prominence of the so-called ‘<RGB FF6D18>dark hero</RGB>’.
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
J'ai entendu dire que les "<RGB FF6D18>anti-héros</RGB>" avaient
le vent en poupe de nos jours.

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
The modern age has ushered the demise of protagonists
of my kind: <RGB FF6D18>the guileless genius</RGB> and champion of justice.
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
L'heure n'est plus aux <RGB FF6D18>chevaliers blancs</RGB>, alliés
de la justice tels que moi.

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
Oh Hurley, that was a masterstroke.
You didn't even bat an eyelid.
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Du Sherlockinou tout craché...
T'arrives encore à mettre ton chapeau, avec ce melon ?

special_movie13_Message_eng.en: ...H-However!

A hero so dark, his suit is as <RGB FF6D18>black as pitch</RGB> and the
dock is his <RGB FF6D18>permanent abode</RGB>?
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Non seulement vous avez <RGB FF6D18>élu résidence</RGB> sur le banc des accusés,
mais de plus, vos vêtements sont <RGB FF6D18>noir de jais</RGB> !

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
That, I posit to the court, is <RGB FF6D18>a shade too far</RGB>!
<RGB FF6D18>Over-egging the black pudding</RGB>!
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Vous conviendrez que vous êtes allé trop <RGB FF6D18>loin</RGB>,
trop <RGB FF6D18>fort</RGB> et trop <RGB FF6D18>vite</RGB> !

special_movie13_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
I think you've overlooked something here, Hurley.
Pardon?

Nearly all the main characters that have appeared in
<RGB FF6D18>Ace Attorney</RGB> over the years...
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Tout les personnage de la série <RGB FF6D18>Ace Attorney</RGB> partagent
un point commun.

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
...have been <RGB FF6D18>defendants</RGB> of some description or
another. And mostly hopeless cases at that.
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Ils ont tous, d'une façon ou d'une autre, été accusés
d'un crime !

special_movie13_Message_eng.en: W-What are you saying?
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr: Tu ne veux pas dire que...

special_movie13_Message_eng.en: I'm saying...

...that being in the dock is a sure sign of a
venerable <RGB FF6D18>Ace Attorney hero</RGB>!
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Le simple fait qu'il soit derrière ce banc aujourd'hui
prouve que Nicky est un véritable <RGB FF6D18>Ace Attorney-Man</RGB> !

special_movie13_Message_eng.en: AAAAAAAAAAAAGH!

Very well. Ladies and gentlemen of the jury, state your
leanings for the court!
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Mesdames et messieurs les jurés, veuillez
à présent rendre votre jugement.

special_movie13_Message_eng.en: Not guilty!
Not guilty!
Not guilty!
Not guilty!
Not guilty!
Not guilty!

It would appear that the jurors are unanimous in
their decision.
Seven-day sinner Ryunosuke Naruhodo...
<CNTR>...on this occasion, the court finds you...</CNTR>
<CNTR>...<RGB FF6D18>not guilty</RGB>!</CNTR>

Dear me. Not the conclusion I would have expected from
a logical and reasonable jury, I must say.
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Eh ben. Je ne pensais pas que de si vénérables jurés
en viendraient à cette conclusion.

special_movie13_Message_eng.en: Thank you very much!

I hereby call an end to this, the sixth of the defendant's
trials this week.
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
La sixième séance pour le jugement de Hikari Yûno
est levée !

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
The next trial is to be <RGB FF6D18>the last</RGB>.
I trust you shall all be in attendance.
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Enfin ! Demain, le <RGB FF6D18>dernier procès</RGB>.
Venez nombreux !

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
That's right! Tomorrow's the day at last!
<RGB FF6D18>The release date</RGB>!
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr: Demain est aussi la <RGB FF6D18>date de sortie officielle</RGB> du jeu !

special_movie13_Message_eng.en:
That is all. Court is adjourned until the final trial
tomorrow evening!
special_movie13_Message_eng.fr:
Au revoir. Le procès reprendra pour
l'<RGB FF6D18>ultime</RGB> nuit.

Are the counsels for the prosecution and defence
ready to proceed with this <RGB FF6D18>final</RGB> trial?
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Enfin la <RGB FF6D18>dernière</RGB> nuit.
Tout le monde est-il prêt ?

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Herlock Sholmes</RGB> for the prosecution, My Lord.
Quite ready, I assure you.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Sherlock Holmes</RGB> pour l'accusation.
Prêt, naturellement.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
<RGB FF6D18>Ryunosuke Naruhodo</RGB> for the defence.
I'm more ready than I've ever been!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
<RGB FF6D18>Hikari Yûno</RGB> pour la défense.
Prêt, votre honneur.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Well well, so you're vacating the dock in favour of
the defence's bench at last, my dear fellow.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Voyez-vous cela...
Vous changez enfin de banc.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
...For the past six days, I've watched my friends
working tirelessly to advocate for me.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Tout le monde s'est battu pour moi pendant
ces six dernières nuits.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
But tonight I'm defending myself! I'll soon show you
who's the fool from this side of the courtroom!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
C'est à moi maintenant !
Je me battrai pour prouver mon innocence !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
That's...a somewhat ambiguous turn of phrase,
Mr Naruhodo.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Euh, Monsieur Nick, quand vous dites
que vous allez vous battre...

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: Let's hope it's not you, Ryunosuke!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Attention à ne pas te prendre une autre
condamnation, Yûno !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <RGB 18D7FA>(Oh...yes...that was a bit unclear...)</RGB>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <RGB 18D7FA>(Vous allez pinailler sur mes mots longtemps ?)</RGB>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: Laudable determination, Mr Naruhodo.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Très belle détermination que vous avez là,
Mister Yûno.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
And most timely. For this evening's proceedings call
for <RGB FF6D18>redoubled</RGB> efforts on my part, too.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Si c'est ce que vous voulez, il est temps pour
moi de sortir le grand jeu.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
You see, the week's earlier accusations pale before
<RGB FF6D18>the great crime</RGB> of which you now stand accused!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Tremblez face à votre péché le plus
horriblement capital !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: Ordaaar! Ordaaar! Orrrdaaar!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Silence dans la salle !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: Mr Sholmes...to what are you referring?
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: D-De quoi parlez-vous ?

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: What is this alleged ‘<RGB FF6D18>great crime</RGB>’?
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Un <RGB FF6D18>péché horriblement capital</RGB> ?

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Very well, Ryunosuke Naruhodo.
I hereby formally charge you...
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Bien, il est temps pour moi de lancer mes accusations.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: ...of the most serious and most heinous <RGB FF6D18>crime</RGB>.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Accusé Hikari Yûno. Je vous accuse d'avoir commis
le plus odieux des <RGB FF6D18>péchés capitaux</RGB>.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: The crime of–
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Je vous accuse de...

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB 18D7FA>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB 18D7FA>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>This farce has gone on long enough.</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>La comédie s'arrête ici !</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: I...am <RGB FF6D18>Lord Barok van Zieks</RGB>.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Mon nom est...
<RGB FF6D18>Drake Van Peers</RGB>.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: Oh my!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Lui-même ?

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
It's, it's the legendary prosecutor known throughout
London as the Reaper of the Bailey!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
C'est un procureur légendaire ! On l'appelle
"Le Dieu de la Mort de l'Old Bailey".

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: The, the Reaper?!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Pardon ?!

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Seven-day sinner Ryunosuke Naruhodo...
the charge is <RGB FF6D18>murder</RGB>!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Pécheur Hikari Yûno...
Vous êtes accusé de <RGB FF6D18>meurtre</RGB> !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Don't be ridiculous!
The defence dismisses the charge outright!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Ridicule !
Je rejette de telles accusations !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
I, I didn't do it!
I would never... I would never kill anyone!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Je n'ai rien fait !
Je n'ai tué personne !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB 18D7FA>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB 18D7FA>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Those eyes please me.
...Nipponese.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: J'aime beaucoup votre regard, Monsieur le Japonais.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
They run wild, clinging to some phantom notion
of courage.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Vous vous accrochez à un courage factice,
mais vos yeux vous trahissent.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: The quintessential look...of a sacrificial lamb.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Ce regard de détresse est parfait pour vous,
qui ne pouvez pas en réchapper... face à moi.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
You will be tried in your own land in the Far East,
the Empire of Japan.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Votre sentence sera rendue sur un archipel
d'Extrême-Orient !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: Court will convene tomorrow, <RGB FF6D18>the 9th July</RGB>!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Le procès sera tenu demain, le <RGB FF6D18>9 juillet</RGB> !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Rest assured, you haven't seen the last of me...
my Nipponese friend.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Nous nous reverrons un jour en justice,
Monsieur le Japonais.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
The time has finally come, Mr Naruhodo!
It's the 9th tomorrow.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
M. Nick ! Le 9 juillet...
est enfin arrivé !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: Well then...it's time to get going!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Eh bien...
Allons-y !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Prosecutor Barok van Zieks...
Ladies and gentlemen of the international jury...
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Procureur Drake Van Peers, ainsi que les membres
du jury du monde entier.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
I swear I'll prove my innocence!
I will win...
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Je vous prouverai mon innocence !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>...in <RGB FF6D18>the full version of the game</RGB>!</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>Dès <RGB FF6D18>la sortie du jeu</RGB>!</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>The Great Ace Attorney</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>A Great Era !</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
The Empire of Japan – after opening its doors,
a push for cultural transformation...
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
L'ouverture des frontières du Japon remonte désormais
à plus d'une décennie...

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
...brought great waves of Western influence
to this Far Eastern island nation.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Notre archipel oriental... s'est retrouvé envahi
sous le déferlement de la culture occidentale.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>The Empire of Japan
in the Meiji Period</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Ère Meiji
Empire japonais</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>An epic tale triggered
by a single shot</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Un coup de feu fatidique
marquant le début du récit</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
But for one man...the turbulence of that era was
just the beginning of an extraordinary story.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
C'est sur un récit particulier dans
cette époque que le rideau va se lever.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>A mysterious murder in a
steamship on the high seas</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Une mystérieuse enquête
sur le Pacifique</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
We must solve this case, Naruhodo-san!
By ourselves if we have to!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Le résolution de cette affaire est entre nos mains

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
So then...let us unravel this mystery...and discover
what events led to this curious murder.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Cette étrange affaire de meurtre...
je vais l'élucider, et y faire toute la lumière !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
<CNTR>To the great capital of the
British Empire, London</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Débarque ensuite à la
capitale de brume, London</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: I will become a lawyer. I have to!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Je deviendrai avocat ! Coûte que coûte !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
I know you can do it, Mr Naruhodo!
I have complete faith in you!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Je sais que vous pouvez y arriver !
Je crois en vous.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: And I shall be observing keenly from the wings.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Moi aussi, je vous laisserai emporter mon cœur
depuis la tribune.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Um...some help would be appreciated actually,
Mr Sholmes.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
En fait... Vous ne pourriez pas nous aider,
M. Holmes ?

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
From the Empire of Japan to the Empire of Great
Britain...a budding lawyer and a great detective...
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Japon et Angleterre.
Avocat et détective.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
...thrown together in the most extraordinary
of circumstances.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Miraculeusement réunis !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection!</RGB></CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR><RGB FF6D18>Objection !</RGB></CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>The Great Ace Attorney: Adventures</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
<CNTR>Ace Attorney: A Great Era
Les aventures de Yûno Hikari</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: <CNTR>On sale tomorrow!</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>En vente dès demain !</CNTR>

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: You don't mean to say...this is <RGB FF6D18>the end</RGB>?
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Est-ce donc, "<RGB FF6D18>la fin</RGB>"... ?

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
But what of <RGB FF6D18>the great crime</RGB> I had prepared for
Mr Naruhodo? He'll be bereft without it!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Que vais-je faire du dernier <RGB FF6D18>péché capital</RGB>
que j'avais préparé ?!

special_movie14_Message_eng.en: Never mind, Hurley.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: Laisse tomber, Sherlockinou.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
We'll just have to wait for Runo and the others at
Baker Street.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: On a plus qu'à attendre Nick et les autres à London.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
At least we can play <RGB FF6D18>The Great Ace Attorney</RGB>
to pass the time!
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Et on jouera à <RGB FF6D18>A Great Era</RGB> pour tuer
le temps !

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
Yes, you're quite right.
We shall be waiting faithfully in London.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Tu as raison. Attendons-les bien sagement ici, à
Baker Street.

special_movie14_Message_eng.en:
So...until we meet again!
I remain your humble savant...Herlock Sholmes.
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr:
Alors, à notre prochaine rencontre !
... C'était Sherlock Holmes.

in the full version!</CNTR>
special_movie14_Message_eng.fr: <CNTR>À suivre dans le jeu !</CNTR>
